source: Skill titles: NNAAP skills listing (Credentia, 2024 outline). Steps: written by Radif Partners in its own words from standard nurse aide practice; the evaluator's checklist in your state handbook is the reference on test day.
opening: Knock, introduce yourself by name and title, and check the client's identity
Explain the procedure in plain words and give the client time to answer
Provide privacy with a curtain, screen or door
closing: Leave the call light or signal device within the client's reach
Leave the bed in its lowest position, with wheels locked
Report any change you noticed to the nurse

skills.title: Hand Hygiene (Hand Washing)
steps: Turn on the water and wet hands and wrists, fingertips pointing down
Apply soap to the hands
Lather all surfaces, between the fingers and around the nails, for at least 20 seconds
Keep the hands lower than the elbows the whole time
Rinse from the wrists down to the fingertips
Dry with a clean paper towel, from fingertips toward the wrists
Turn off the faucet with a clean, dry paper towel
Discard the towel without touching the waste container with your hands

skills.title: Applies One Knee-High Elastic Stocking
steps: Have the client lying down before the stocking goes on
Turn the stocking inside out down to the heel
Slip the foot of the stocking over the toes, foot and heel
Pull the rest of the stocking up over the leg, smooth and without twists or wrinkles
Check that the heel sits in the heel of the stocking and the toe opening lies flat
Avoid force and keep the leg supported throughout

skills.title: Assists to Ambulate Using Transfer Belt
steps: Lock the bed wheels and have the client put on nonskid footwear
Help the client sit on the edge of the bed with feet flat on the floor
Apply the transfer belt snugly at the waist, over clothing, with room for your fingers
Grip the belt from underneath with both hands and give a signal before standing
Help the client stand, then walk slightly behind and to the weaker side, holding the belt
Walk the agreed distance, then help the client back to bed or chair
Remove the transfer belt once the client is seated safely

skills.title: Assists With Use of Bedpan
steps: Put on gloves
Lower the head of the bed and position the client on the back
Place the bedpan correctly, wide end under the buttocks, by having the client raise the hips or roll
Raise the head of the bed so the client is in a sitting position
Leave tissue and the call light within reach and step out if the client is safe alone
Remove the bedpan, cover it, and help clean the perineal area front to back
Empty and rinse the bedpan into the toilet, and store it
Remove gloves and help the client wash the hands

skills.title: Cleans Upper or Lower Denture
steps: Put on gloves
Line the sink with a towel or washcloth to cushion the denture
Hold the denture over the sink while handling it
Brush all surfaces with a denture brush and denture cleanser or toothpaste
Rinse under cool running water
Place the denture in a clean cup with cool water or solution, or give it back to the client
Rinse and store the brush, then remove gloves

skills.title: Counts and Records Radial Pulse
steps: Place your fingertips on the thumb side of the inner wrist
Count the beats for one full minute
Record the pulse rate right away
Compare with the evaluator's count: it must fall within the margin your handbook allows

skills.title: Counts and Records Respirations
steps: Count respirations while the client is unaware, for example while still holding the wrist after the pulse
Count one rise and fall of the chest as one respiration
Count for one full minute
Record the rate right away and compare with the evaluator's count

skills.title: Donning and Removing PPE (Gown and Gloves)
steps: Pick up the gown and unfold it, opening toward you
Put arms in the sleeves and tie the gown at the neck and the waist
Put on gloves, pulling the cuffs over the gown sleeves
To remove, take off the first glove by pinching it at the palm, then slide a bare finger inside the second
Untie the gown and pull it away from the neck and shoulders, touching only the inside
Turn the gown inside out as it comes off and roll it away from the body
Discard the gown and gloves in the proper container
Perform hand hygiene

skills.title: Dresses Client with Affected (Weak) Right Arm
steps: Ask the client which clothing to wear
Remove the gown from the strong side first, then from the weak side
Put the sleeve on the weak right arm first
Then put the sleeve on the strong left arm
Finish dressing with as little movement of the weak arm as possible
Leave the client comfortable and the clothing straight

skills.title: Feeds Client Who Cannot Feed Self
steps: Check the name on the tray against the client and the diet card
Position the client upright, at 75 to 90 degrees
Clean the client's hands before the meal
Sit at eye level facing the client
Offer small bites and sips, telling the client what each food is
Give the client time to chew and swallow before the next bite
Wipe the mouth and hands at the end
Record the share of food eaten and the fluid intake in mL

skills.title: Gives Modified Bed Bath (Face and One Arm, Hand and Underarm)
steps: Remove or fold back the gown and cover the client with a bath blanket
Check the water temperature is comfortable and safe before use
Wash the eyes with water only, from the inner corner to the outer, a clean part of the cloth for each eye
Wash, rinse and dry the face
Place a towel under the arm and wash, rinse and dry the hand, arm and underarm
Put a clean gown on the client
Empty and rinse the basin and dispose of linens properly

skills.title: Measures and Records Electronic Blood Pressure
steps: Choose the right cuff size and wipe the cuff if the facility requires it
Have the client sit or lie with the arm supported at heart level
Place the cuff on the bare upper arm, with the artery mark over the brachial artery
Start the machine and ask the client to keep still and quiet
Read the systolic and diastolic values once the reading is complete
Remove the cuff and record the reading right away

skills.title: Measures and Records Urinary Output
steps: Put on gloves
Pour the contents of the bedpan or collection device into a graduate
Set the graduate on a flat surface and read it at eye level
Empty the urine into the toilet and rinse the equipment
Remove gloves and perform hand hygiene
Record the amount in mL, within the margin your handbook allows

skills.title: Measures and Records Weight of Ambulatory Client
steps: Have the client wear nonskid footwear
Check that the scale reads zero before use
Help the client step onto the center of the scale
Read the weight once the client stands still without holding on
Help the client off the scale
Record the weight right away

skills.title: Performs Modified Passive Range of Motion (PROM) for One Knee and One Ankle
steps: Position the client on the back, lying flat
Support the leg at the knee and the ankle
Bend the knee and hip, then straighten them, at least three times
Support the foot and ankle and push the foot up, then down, at least three times
Move each joint gently, without pain, and ask the client to report any discomfort

skills.title: Performs Modified Passive Range of Motion (PROM) for One Shoulder
steps: Support the arm at the elbow and the wrist
Raise the straight arm up over the head and bring it back down, at least three times
Move the straight arm away from the side and back toward the body, at least three times
Move gently, stopping at any sign of pain, and ask the client to report discomfort

skills.title: Positions on Side
steps: Lower the head of the bed and raise the side rail on the side the client will turn toward
Move the client toward you, to the near side of the bed
Bend the client's knee and turn the client gently toward the raised rail
Place a pillow behind the back to support the position
Support the top arm and the top leg with pillows, with no limb pressing on another
Check that the head is supported and the body is aligned

skills.title: Provides Catheter Care for Female
steps: Put on gloves and place a protective pad under the perineal area
Expose only the area around the catheter
Separate the labia and wash the area where the catheter enters, with soap and water
Hold the catheter near the meatus and wash at least four inches down the tubing, moving away from the body
Use a clean part of the cloth for each stroke, then rinse and dry the same way
Keep the drainage bag below the level of the bladder and the tubing free of kinks
Remove gloves and perform hand hygiene

skills.title: Provides Foot Care on One Foot
steps: Check the water temperature is safe before use
Place the basin on a protective barrier at the client's feet
Soak the foot in the water
Wash the entire foot, including between the toes, then rinse
Dry the foot thoroughly, especially between the toes
Apply lotion to the top and the bottom of the foot, not between the toes
Support the foot and ankle throughout

skills.title: Provides Mouth Care
steps: Put on gloves and raise the head of the bed
Place a towel across the chest
Brush the teeth, the inner and outer surfaces, and the tongue gently
Have the client rinse and spit into an emesis basin
Wipe the mouth and remove the towel
Rinse and store the equipment, then remove gloves

skills.title: Provides Perineal Care (Peri-Care) for Female
steps: Put on gloves and place a protective pad under the buttocks
Check the water temperature is safe before use
Wash the genital area from front to back, using a clean part of the washcloth for each stroke
Rinse and dry the area from front to back the same way
Turn the client and wash, rinse and dry the rectal area from front to back
Remove the pad, dispose of linens properly and remove gloves

skills.title: Transfers from Bed to Wheelchair Using Transfer Belt
steps: Place the wheelchair at the side of the bed, lock its brakes and lift or move the footrests
Lock the bed wheels and help the client put on nonskid footwear
Help the client sit on the edge of the bed with feet flat on the floor
Apply the transfer belt snugly at the waist over clothing
Grip the belt from underneath, block the client's knees if needed, and give a signal before standing
Help the client stand, pivot and sit down in the wheelchair
Remove the belt, position the feet on the footrests and check the client sits well back in the seat

skills.title: Measures and Records Manual Blood Pressure
steps: Clean the earpieces and diaphragm of the stethoscope
Have the client's arm bare, supported and at heart level
Wrap the right size cuff on the upper arm, above the elbow
Locate the brachial pulse and place the diaphragm over it
Inflate the cuff to the level your handbook gives, then deflate it slowly and steadily
Note the first sound (systolic) and the point the sound disappears (diastolic)
Deflate the cuff fully, remove it, and record the reading within the allowed margin
